meta.title: Prompt sent with the Enter key

steps.note: Open the event creation flow containing the technical-stage RFP Generator.
Provide the required event title for the create screen.
Configure the event with a Technical/RFP stage.
Work on the technical stage where the RFP Generator is available.
Apply a technical template before adding line items and using the generator.
Provide the line item context used by the RFP Generator.
Open the RFP Generator AI chat panel.

args.goal: in the open RFP Generator AI chat, choose a section, type an instruction in its textbox, press Enter instead of Send, and verify that the prompt is submitted and the chosen section changes as it does when using Send

steps.note: Perform and verify the Enter-key submission and resulting AI section update, which no dedicated catalog step can express.
Confirm the chat submission and section update did not produce an application error.
